---
title: "GSE306201 integrated Seurat object"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r}
library(Seurat)
```
```{r}
# Integrated Seurat object for GSE306201, placed in this folder
seurat_obj = readRDS("Integrated_Dataset_raw_seurobj.rds")
```

```{r}
print(seurat_obj) 
print(paste("Number of cells:", ncol(seurat_obj))) 
print(paste("Number of genes:", nrow(seurat_obj)))  
 # Check metadata columns 
print("Metadata columns:") 
print(colnames(seurat_obj@meta.data)) 
  # Check cell types 
print("Cell type distribution:") 
print(table(seurat_obj@meta.data$major_celltype)) 
  # Check assays
print("Available assays:") 
print(names(seurat_obj@assays))
```
